notes.title: We fix our sh*t and added Spanish localization
notes.content:
Okay, this is a big *ss update, which was supposed to ship on the anniversary of the game, but you know life happens, so we had to delay it a little bit.

So, okay...

We did an English Test pass of the whole game, which might have reduced the maximum number of grammatical mistakes in the whole *ss game.
-We were finally able to pay for the Spanish localization, which is centered in the Mexican accent.
-As we're preparing the PlayStation and Switch versions, you're now able to use a dual shock controller for the game.
-We did a lot of optimization, especially in the reset parts in endings 2 and 3, so that hopefully it runs better on lower-end hardware.
-We make some of the puzzles a little bit easier, especially the trash bags, paper, scissors, and rock minigames, so that they will be a little less frustrating for some players, as we saw some people in agony, which we enjoy, but not that much.
-We also made a new version of the Demo with the Spanish localization and Linux ports, so if you wanted to share it with your friends or show the game to your friends for free, then you're able to do that.

-Thanks for your time, thanks for your patience, and for reading this.

This is literally the first game that we have finished on our own, and we wanted to grow and see what works and what doesn't, so if you want to leave your feedback in any way that you want, please tell us.

Regards, and I hope that you have a great start to your year.

notes.title: LINUX PORT!
notes.content:
We made a full LINUX PORT, and we fixed some shaders so that it would work on Linux but it works natively now.

The Steam deck still uses the Windows port, but you can force the Linux one on settings.

We also made some fixes to the Steam deck version, mostly with some shaders that didn't work as well as we hoped and some UI elements, which glitched when you changed from 16x9 to 16x10.

notes.title: DECK END IS NAHUAL
notes.content:
We just finished a major update is upon us for the game The End Is Nahual: If I may say so.

We finished the port for the STEAM DECK, got the certification, and implemented cross-platform cloud saves, but it's still not the native Linux port; I'm also working on it, which shall be done later next month.

Fixed multiple UI glitches that happened when you changed the aspect ratio of the game from 16x9 to 16x10.

Fixed multiple full-screen images to accommodate the new aspect ratio of 16x10.

Fixed camera size to accommodate the change in aspect ratio, depending on the level.

We added full support for the aspect ratio of 16x10. 

Multiple bug fixes and code optimizations were implemented.
It runs really well on steam deck you can get 95% of the time 60 fps on 5 Watts… it’s insane...
